records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached 7/4 but no activity since; no invite sent despite two nudges (email:5aaa85a4, email:1f6f3df2), zero customer replies, and a no-show welcome call (calendar:50a015ba). Starter, solo admin, no tickets — low engagement signals suggest unaided milestone within 8 days is unlikely.

draft.subject: Picking up where we left off
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Sorry we missed each other on Monday — no problem at all. You've already got your first project going in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them.

The next step that usually makes it click is getting one teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week work to walk through that together? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
